name: Addon statistics - Usability Tab
description:
**Why?**
The new Shoptet Partner Portal (Figma: Moje doplňky → Statistiky doplňků) needs to show partners their addon **usability** stats (Použitelnost tab). Today that data only exists inside the admin's API Partner section (`ApiPartnerController`, views `statsUsabilityView`/`statsUsabilityDetailView`).

**What?**
Implement the Partner Portal's "Statistiky doplňků" screen — **Použitelnost** tab — per the linked Figma design, reusing the standalone controller extracted from `ApiPartnerController` (see CZ3TDR1-658) so no business logic is duplicated between admin and Partner Portal.

Pozn.: Fakturace tab a samotná extrakce controlleru jsou řešeny v CZ3TDR1-658.

**Acceptance Criteria**

- Shoptet Partner Portal's "Moje doplňky → Statistiky doplňků" screen — **Použitelnost tab** — is implemented per Figma and served by the controller extracted in CZ3TDR1-658
- No duplicated business logic vs. the admin's existing usability views
- Unit/integration tests cover the usability tab behaviour

**Resources**

- Figma — Použitelnost tab: https://www.figma.com/design/uyNyEpBk6MYXqjXprmXftl/Partner-Portal?node-id=657-53310&m=dev
- Current implementation: `admin/controllers/ApiPartnerController.php`, `admin/react/src/Core/pages/ApiPartner/`
- Related: CZ3TDR1-658 (Fakturace tab, controller extraction)
